record_title: A 9-by-9 elementary grading with no finite regrading
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The cases n=4,5,6,7,8 are not resolved; the result only gives 3 <= n_0 <= 8.
No claim is made that the universal group of the displayed grading is Baumslag's group.
No claim is made for the additional universal-Hopf or coaction properties of the separate n>=14 construction of Gordienko and Pekarsky.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an unindexed equivalent small-dimensional construction or correction may exist.
